---
title: "Single Point Bid Curve Numbers"
format: md
echo: false
---

```{r}
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(duckplyr)
use("here", "here")
```

# Single Point Curves

```{r}
here("CASIO_dam_big.parquet") |>
  read_parquet_duckdb() |>
  summarise(
    n_points = n(),
    .by = c(RESOURCEBID_SEQ, STARTTIME)
  ) |>
  filter(n_points == 1L) |>
  summarise(one_point_curves = n()) |>
  pull(one_point_curves)
```

# Single Point Curves with nonnull x and y

```{r}
here("CASIO_dam_big.parquet") |>
  read_parquet_duckdb() |>
  filter(
    !is.na(SCH_BID_XAXISDATA),
    !is.na(SCH_BID_Y1AXISDATA)
  ) |>
  summarise(
    n_points = n(),
    .by = c(STARTTIME, RESOURCEBID_SEQ)
  ) |>
  filter(n_points == 1L) |>
  summarise(n_single = n()) |>
  pull(n_single)
```

# Number of unique generators which submitted single point curves

```{r}
here("CASIO_dam_big.parquet") |>
  read_parquet_duckdb() |>
  filter(
    !is.na(SCH_BID_XAXISDATA),
    !is.na(SCH_BID_Y1AXISDATA)
  ) |>
  summarise(
    n_points = n(),
    .by = c(STARTTIME, RESOURCEBID_SEQ)
  ) |>
  filter(n_points == 1L) |>
  summarise(n_generators_single_point = n_distinct(RESOURCEBID_SEQ)) |>
  pull(n_generators_single_point)
```

Total number of generators:

```{r}
here("CASIO_dam_big.parquet") |>
  read_parquet_duckdb() |>
  summarise(n_generators = n_distinct(RESOURCEBID_SEQ)) |>
  pull(n_generators)
```

250 / 4191 * 100

# Single-point curves at each generator's global max MW

```{r}
dam_nonnull <- here("CASIO_dam_big.parquet") |>
  read_parquet_duckdb() |>
  filter(
    !is.na(SCH_BID_XAXISDATA),
    !is.na(SCH_BID_Y1AXISDATA)
  )

generator_max <- dam_nonnull |>
  summarise(
    generator_max_mw = max(SCH_BID_XAXISDATA),
    .by = RESOURCEBID_SEQ
  )

single_point_curves <- dam_nonnull |>
  summarise(
    n_points = n(),
    point_mw = max(SCH_BID_XAXISDATA),
    .by = c(RESOURCEBID_SEQ, STARTTIME)
  ) |>
  filter(n_points == 1L)

single_point_curves |>
  inner_join(generator_max, by = "RESOURCEBID_SEQ") |>
  mutate(at_generator_max = abs(point_mw - generator_max_mw) < 1e-9) |>
  summarise(
    n_single_point_curves = n(),
    n_single_point_at_generator_max = sum(at_generator_max),
    pct_single_point_at_generator_max = 100 * sum(at_generator_max) / n()
  ) |>
  collect()
```

# Distribution of single-point bids as percent of generator max MW

```{r}
single_point_curves |>
  inner_join(generator_max, by = "RESOURCEBID_SEQ") |>
  filter(generator_max_mw > 0) |>
  mutate(pct_of_generator_max = 100 * point_mw / generator_max_mw) |>
  select(RESOURCEBID_SEQ, STARTTIME, pct_of_generator_max) |>
  collect() |>
  ggplot(aes(x = pct_of_generator_max)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 5, fill = "#00008b", color = "white") +
  labs(
    title = "Single-Point Bid MW as % of Generator Max MW",
    x = "Single-point MW (% of generator max MW)",
    y = "Number of single-point curves"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
